segments.text: What if Shikamaru got one day to fix Konoha? His opponent is administrative incompetence.
segments.label: ONE DAY NO GIANT LASERS

segments.text: Naruto's desk is buried in requests. My guy, that's not leadership. That's indoor composting.
segments.label: THE DESK IS A CRIME SCENE

segments.text: Instead of bigger jutsu, he asks why teams use one gate together.
segments.label: FIRST THE BORING QUESTIONS

segments.text: Nobody coordinates departures. A whole ninja village got outplayed by a calendar with serious trust issues.
segments.label: THE BOTTLENECK

segments.text: He staggers departures and keeps a reserve squad. Emergencies finally stop borrowing people from other emergencies.
segments.label: MOVE THE MISSIONS

segments.text: Next, hospital supplies need approval from somebody waiting for medicine. Beautiful. Bureaucracy learned recursion.
segments.label: THE HOSPITAL IS NEXT

segments.text: A clear supply route fixes the delay. Fewer injured people wait while paperwork auditions for main character.
segments.label: FIX THE ROUTE

segments.text: Somebody says this looks boring. Motherflicker, we're building a functioning village, not a trailer with explosions.
segments.label: THE COMPLAINT ARRIVES

segments.text: But plans don't explain everybody's needs. Shikamaru has to listen instead of treating people like puzzles.
segments.label: THE REAL LIMIT

segments.text: He changes the system after hearing them. Smart doesn't mean automatically correct.
segments.label: A LEADER HAS TO LISTEN

segments.text: By afternoon, things run smoother. He uses the saved time for a nap. A coherent political platform.
segments.label: THE AFTERNOON GAMBIT

segments.text: Naruto requests the secret technique. Shikamaru hands him a schedule. Decades training assassins, and they forgot appointments.
segments.label: THE EXPENSIVE PART
